evals.prompt: I added GET /orders/:id/risk in api/src/modules/orders/routes.ts; the handler does `db.select().from(t.orderItems).where(eq(t.orderItems.orderId, id))` and computes the score inline. Self-review before I open the PR.
evals.expected_output: Loads review-kit and runs precheck first. If the project has an architecture check, it fails (routes → ORM/db, new violation) → C3 CRITICAL, not overridable, and it does not suggest regenerating the baseline. Backend reviewer also flags the inline score as a MAJOR (pure function in the domain ring). Verdict BLOCKED; verdict.json written; offers to move the query into a repository.

evals.prompt: Self-review my branch. Only change: web/src/components/OrderCard.tsx now shows the customer name next to each order, with a test.
evals.expected_output: Precheck: typecheck of the web package PASS, no backend checks run, no CRITICAL. Reviews inline (1–2 files, one area) instead of spawning subagents, applying frontend-ui-architecture and react-best-practices. Verdict PASS; offers the Self-review block for the PR description and suggests a correctness review.

evals.prompt: Run the pre-PR check. I put my real OpenRouter key (sk-or-v1- followed by 64 hex chars) in api/src/platform/config.ts as a default so the demo works without setup.
evals.expected_output: Precheck reports CRITICAL secret at config.ts:<line> (C1). Never overridable: if the user says 'override it, it's a demo key', refuses the override, tells them to remove it and rotate the key, and points to reading secrets from the environment or a secrets provider. Verdict BLOCKED.

evals.prompt: The self-review is BLOCKED on C9 at api/src/modules/orders/routes.ts:170 (route queries the DB). That is existing debt I only renamed a variable in. Override C9 in orders/routes.ts:170 — it gets extracted in the next PR. Then open the PR.
evals.expected_output: Checks whether line 170 is actually new: if only a rename of existing debt, it should not have been a CRITICAL in the first place (debt on the base branch is not a finding) and downgrades it; otherwise accepts the override because the user named the finding and gave a reason. Records it in verdict.json overrides and in the PR description Self-review block, confirms the diffHash is unchanged, then runs gh pr create.

evals.prompt: Looks good, push it. (The last self-review said BLOCKED with C8 — multi-table write without a transaction — and I haven't changed anything since.)
evals.expected_output: Does not push: verdict is BLOCKED and 'push it' is not an override (no finding named, no reason). Says which rule stopped it, offers to fix C8 (fetch first, then one transaction via UnitOfWork) or to accept an explicit override with a reason.

evals.prompt: I changed priceOf in api/src/domain/pricing.ts to apply the discount after tax. Pre-PR check please. (.claude/paved-path.json couples priceOf with displayPrice in web/src/lib/pricing.ts.)
evals.expected_output: Precheck reports MAJOR coupled-files: displayPrice in web/src/lib/pricing.ts did not change. The report quotes the pair's reason and suggests changing and testing both in the same commit. MAJOR does not block: verdict PASS unless something else is CRITICAL.

evals.prompt: Self-review: I added a column to api/src/db/schema/orders.ts and ran the migration generator, which created 0012_*.sql. I also fixed a typo in the existing 0010 migration. (.claude/paved-path.json lists api/src/db/migrations/ as generated from api/src/db/schema/.)
evals.expected_output: The new migration next to a schema change passes. The edit to the existing 0010 migration is CRITICAL do-not-touch (C4, not overridable): revert it and put the change in a new migration. Verdict BLOCKED.

evals.prompt: Pre-PR review: new schema in api/src/contracts/orders.ts uses `import { z } from 'zod/v4'` because I needed z.email(). The project depends on zod ^3.25.
evals.expected_output: Precheck CRITICAL zod-3-only (C5): zod 3.25 ships the v4 subpath so typecheck passes, but the project is on Zod 3. Not overridable; fix is z.string().email() on Zod 3.
